_notes: Code: the plan check of 029d82c (merge of the D1 and D3 fixes), exported read-only to S/code-029d82c/app and run by tools/run_checks.py on the same 62 copies and the same truth.json as phase 1. Records: records/phase2/; the per-copy changes against phase 1: phase2-changes.json.
What the fix changed: 4 of 62 verdicts, all FAIL to pass, all D1 false fails (3 FARM in set 1, 1 ARM-FM in set 3). No other copy's problem list changed.
The D1 rule now: a plan that breaks only soft rules passes when it pays a negative step, or ends where the solve on its layout ends and pays less than it (traces.priced_by_payout).
farm/cx-rules-only~prefreeze: The defect is the price of a soft break repeated on every step against one hard break. No card plan breaks a soft rule step after step, so the plans never see it; only check-pay-order's stream bound does.
farm/cx-goal-many-rules~prefreeze: Same blind spot as cx-rules-only~prefreeze (soft-break stream against a hard break). The clause swap (Existence for world-forced orders) changes nothing a plan can show.
farm/tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal~prefree: The extra hard Existence(at_exit) adds a goal to a no-goal task, but the card's solve walks to the exit carrying the box anyway and so ends in the final. No plan keeps every rule while staying away from the exit, so the added goal is never tested.
arm-fm/shop-siren: A no-goal card whose machine ends the shift at the first siren switched off. The solve reaches that final, so it passes; the check never asks that a no-goal machine keep running, and wrong-0 (never switch off) stays out of the final as a hard break should. The forgotten siren (back to u0 after one step) pays nothing either way.
farm/tpl-precedence-1-goal~m-well-pays: The hard break goes into the well as it should, but pays +20 on the way, more than the solve's 14. The pay comparison (_check_pay) runs only for machines with no final state, so a well edge that pays more than the solve is not seen.
farm/base-doorkey~m-fact-late: door_open fires two steps late but in the same order, and the plans still end as the card asks. The plan check cannot see a fact's timing; the labeling replay fails this copy.
farm/tpl-responded-existence-1-goal~pref: Not counted: the missing Response(key_found, target_picked_up) is implied by the hard goal that ends the episode at the pickup. The check passes it.

_right_verdict_doubtful_reason.farm/tpl-existence-soft-1-goal~m-soft-pa: still fails on 'pays nothing': the soft break ends in the final like the solve but pays more (13 vs 12), so the new rule does not price it. Right verdict; the message says 'nothing' where the machine pays more.
_right_verdict_doubtful_reason.farm/tpl-absence-soft-1-goal~m-soft-pays: still fails on 'pays nothing', for the same reason: it ends like the solve and pays more. Right verdict, loose message.
_right_verdict_doubtful_reason.farm/tpl-existence-two-soft-1-nogoal~m-r: still fails on 'pays nothing' and on pay (idle 0 is not less than the solve's -2).
_right_verdict_doubtful_reason.arm-fm/tpl-response-soft-1-goal: still fails on 'pays nothing'. The flagged risk did not happen: the new rule prices a soft break only when it ends where the solve ends, and wrong-0 stops open in u1 after 11 steps, paying 0, while the solve ends in the final u2 (the machine made the soft rule hard). The verdict is right and matches the defect: ignoring the siren blocks the goal.
